description:
Searches all sources (French and European case law, codes and
statutes, Journal officiel, collective agreements, doctrine), expanding to
legal synonyms. Entry point for an open question; for one specific court,
use `search_case_law`. A citation ("Cass. soc. 11 mai 2022", an ECLI, an
appeal number) is recognised and searched as such. Singular and plural are
searched together; "in double quotes": the exact word. Query in French:
the data is French (some ECHR/CJEU texts are English only).

Example: search(query="harcèlement moral fonctionnaire")

Args:
    query: keywords or a citation; OR/AND/NOT/NEAR in UPPERCASE between two
        words are operators (NEAR = within 10 words); lowercase words are plain words
    sources: dila, jade, legi, cedh, cjue, kali, jorf, doctrine (empty: all)
    sort: relevance | date_desc | date_asc
    date_min: YYYY-MM-DD (all sources)
    date_max: YYYY-MM-DD
    limit: results (max 100)
    expand_synonyms: expand to legal synonyms (default true)
